fusions.name: Gorging Bite
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You bite for 8 damage, leave the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shared Spoils
fusions.desc: Tears into every enemy within 3 tiles for 26 damage. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolted Meal
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
